implemented: typed discourse query IR for source content, proposition sources, actuality, modality, conflict, and presupposition checks

English and Korean source-content and proposition-source questions

architecture.question_path: normalized question -> typed discourse query -> source, attitude, topic, time, and modal filters -> bounded belief evidence -> typed claims -> bilingual realization
architecture.authority_path: dialogue record -> evidence citation only -> no world-truth or execution authority
architecture.planning_boundary: recognized discourse question -> no GoalIR planning, no semantic plan hash, no task frame, no new belief

development_counterexamples.observed: Question verbs such as expect, want, Korean 보고했어, and 알고 있어 leaked into topic matching and hid valid records.
development_counterexamples.repair: Separated open proposition terms from bilingual interrogative and attitude-function terms.

development_counterexamples.observed: English expletive it and complementizer that were treated as unresolved discourse referents in actuality and factive questions.
development_counterexamples.repair: Allowed only those bounded syntactic forms through the query path while retaining ordinary ambiguous-reference rejection.

development_counterexamples.observed: Expect and want complements lost their predicted and desired worlds when the complement itself lacked a modal token.
development_counterexamples.repair: Projected typed attribution attitude into the complement world only when the proposition parser otherwise returned Actual.

development_counterexamples.observed: Valid versus invalid, ready versus not ready, and 정상 versus 비정상 records were not recognized as semantic oppositions.
development_counterexamples.repair: Extended local state axes with longest-match integrity, readiness, and abnormal-state markers.

development_counterexamples.observed: Known source Ann could capture the unknown queried source Annabelle by substring.
development_counterexamples.repair: Required ASCII actor boundaries while preserving Korean particle attachment.

development_counterexamples.observed: Modal answers exposed correct typed worlds but used generic source-record wording.
development_counterexamples.repair: Added query-kind-specific modal and source-identification realization with explicit non-truth language.

known_limits: Question recognition still uses a bounded deterministic bilingual grammar rather than a general syntactic-semantic parser.
Topic matching is lexical and local; it does not yet perform general paraphrase entailment or ontology-mediated retrieval.
Presuppositional questions currently abstain when unverified but do not yet answer from independently verified event records.
Exact event time, report time, intervals, recurring events, and temporal question answering remain coarse.
Long-distance pronoun, nominal, and implicit actor coreference remains limited.
Source reliability, evidence strength, and external world verification are deliberately absent from dialogue-only answers.
Quantified questions, multi-hop relational questions, ellipsis, and broad open-domain wh-forms are incomplete.
No broad open-domain corpus, human calibration study, or frontier-model comparison has been run.
The system remains below GPT-grade breadth, robustness, knowledge, and calibration.
next_frontier: typed event and temporal relation graph with when, before, after, while, duration, and report-time distinctions
verified conditional-guard activation without reverse inference
long-distance actor, entity, event, and belief-holder coreference
compositional paraphrase and ontology-mediated query matching instead of surface-term overlap
multi-hop relational question answering with explicit proof paths and abstention
larger family-held-out adversarial dialogue suites and human-calibrated evaluation
